name: FLUKA vs GEANT4 carbon ion therapy benchmark
description: Comparative benchmark evaluating nuclear interaction models in FLUKA and GEANT4 for carbon ion therapy dosimetry and secondary particle production.
evaluation_method: statistical_comparison (e.g., percent dose difference, gamma-index, secondary particle yield comparisons)
general_score_metric: dose agreement metrics (gamma-index / percent dose difference) and particle yield agreement
reputation: Highly relevant to the medical physics community—FLUKA and GEANT4 are widely used toolkits; direct comparative studies are respected but relatively specialized.
notes: Non-ML, domain-specific simulation benchmark; results strongly dependent on physics lists, model settings and geometry; computationally expensive and sensitive to statistical uncertainties in Monte Carlo runs.
